intro.text: A spren bonded to Arshqqam, travelling with the expedition to the honorspren.
A mistspren bonded to Arshqqam, travelling with the expedition to the honorspren.

items.text: When Arshqqam left Tashikk for Urithiru, she and Dreaming-though-Awake were chosen for the expedition to the honorspren. In Shadesmar the spren began studying the humans at once, quizzing Adolin and translating for Arshqqam.
On the journey, Dreaming-though-Awake was disappointed to find Shallan sketching her rather than the Unmade, and had no answers to Shallan's questions about Ba-Ado-Mishram.
After Adolin, Shallan, Maya and Pattern entered Lasting Integrity, Arshqqam and Dreaming-though-Awake left with the others to carry word to Dalinar.

appearance.text: In Shadesmar she looks like a woman made of mist, with a porcelain mask for a face and a vest, trousers and gloves. She seems to drift rather than walk.

personality.text: Dreaming-though-Awake is fascinated by humans, finding their questions revealing, in a way that people find somewhat off-putting.
